Decline Bench Press.setup: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet.
steps: Grasp the bar at a grip 3-6 inches wider than your shoulders.
Raise the bar above your chest, keeping your elbows close in.
Slowly and with control lower the bar straight to your lower chest.
Raise the bar back up to starting position with the bar just above your chest.
Repeat.

Weighted Push-up.setup: Start in a push-up position with hands just wider than your shoulders, a weight plate or loaded pack secured on your upper back, and your body in one straight line.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to lock your body into a plank.
Lower your chest to just above the floor with elbows about 45 degrees from your sides.
Keep your neck neutral and your gaze a little ahead of your hands.
Press the floor away until your arms are straight.
Pause briefly at the top, then repeat for all reps without letting the load shift.

Reverse Pec Deck.setup: Sit facing the pad with your chest against it, seat height set so the handles are at shoulder level, and hold the handles with arms nearly straight.
steps: Set your shoulder blades gently back and down before you move.
Sweep your arms out and back in a wide arc, leading with your elbows.
Stop when your arms are in line with your torso and squeeze for a second.
Control the handles forward until you feel a stretch across your rear shoulders.
Repeat without letting the weight stack touch down between reps.

Barbell Upright Row.setup: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your abs drawn in and back straight.
steps: Place the bar on rack in the position where your arms are fully extended in front of you with your elbows slightly bent.
Place your hands shoulder width apart and raise the bar up towards your chin with a controlled motion.
Pause at the top for a moment and rotate your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar to the starting position.
Repeat.
cues: Do not arch your back when raising the barbell towards your chin.

Dumbbell Bent-Over Row.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding dumbbells, hinge at the hips until your torso is near 45 degrees, knees soft and back flat, arms hanging straight down.
steps: Brace your core and keep your neck in line with your spine.
Pull the dumbbells toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top for a beat.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are straight.
Hold the same hinge angle for every rep.
mistakes: Standing up as the weight gets heavy

Close-Grip Lat Pulldown.setup: Attach a V bar to the pull down pulley of a cable machine.
steps: Sitting upright with your abs drawn grasp the bar with an overhand grip, your palms facing in.
Pull the bar straight down to your upper chest.
Pause for a moment after touching the chest and then slowly return the bar to starting position.
Repeat.

Straight-Arm Pulldown.setup: Grasp wide grip pull down bar with a wide grip so your hands are on the portion of the bar which curves down.
steps: Stand erect with your abs drawn in.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows and your wrist steady pull the bar down from the starting position to your upper thighs.
With a controlled motion bring the bar back up to starting position.

Skull Crusher.setup: Lie on a flat bench with your head at one end.
steps: Grasp an EZ or Curl bar with an overhand grip.
Raise the bar straight up over your shoulders, taking care to keep your elbows in close.
Slowly lower the bar in an arc over your head.
Return the bar to the starting position.
Note: Keep your arms straight throughout this exercise moving only your elbows.

Cable Crunch.setup: Attach a rope to a high cable pulley.
steps: Place a bench in front of cable weight stack.
Grasp the rope over your shoulders and sit with your back towards the stack.
With your feet firmly on the floor and keeping your hips steady, flex at the waist bringing your elbows towards your knees.
Return to the starting position.
Note: Perform this exercise in a slow controlled manner.

Incline Cable Fly.setup: Place an incline bench set at a 45 degree angle between two cable towers.
steps: Grasp a pulley in each hand with your palms facing up.
With a slight bend in your elbows, squeeze your chest and pull the cables in an arc so they meet together in the middle of your chest.
Hold for a moment and then slowly lower your hands back to starting position at along the same arc.

Decline Dumbbell Press.setup: Grasp the dumbbells your hands and lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet.
steps: Raise the dumbbells above your chest, bringing your elbows close in, this is your starting position.
Slowly and with control lower the dumbbells to either side of your lower chest.
Raise the dumbbells back up to starting position.

Landmine Press.setup: Wedge one end of a barbell in a corner or landmine base, stand facing it in a split or staggered stance, and hold the free end at your shoulder with one hand.
steps: Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the bar up and forward along its natural arc until your arm is nearly straight.
Reach slightly at the top so your shoulder blade rotates with the bar.
Lower the bar under control back to your shoulder.
Finish all reps on one arm, then switch sides.
mistakes: Letting the bar drift away from you

Chest Dip.setup: Stand in between the parallel bars.
steps: Grip the handles of the parallel bars and push yourself up to the starting position with straightened arms.
With your elbows close to your body keep your hips straight, lower your body forward by bending your elbows so your chest is leading as you go down.
Raise yourself back up to the starting position and repeat.
Repeat.
cues: Ensure not to lock your elbows once you have raised yourself up.

Standing Dumbbell Press.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing forward and forearms vertical.
steps: Squeeze your glutes and brace your core so your ribs stay down.
Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Move your head slightly forward at the top so your ears sit between your arms.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back to shoulder height.
Keep your knees soft and your feet planted for every rep.

Machine Lateral Raise.setup: Sit with your back against the pad, seat set so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot, and place your forearms or hands against the pads at your sides.
steps: Keep your shoulders relaxed and down away from your ears.
Raise your arms out to the sides, leading with your elbows.
Stop when your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Hold the top for a moment, then lower slowly.
Stop just short of letting the stack rest before the next rep.

Cable Front Raise.setup: Place the pulley on the setting just above the floor.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your abs drawn in and your knees slightly bent.
Starting at waist height, take the pulley in your left hand, palm facing the floor with otherwise known as an overhand grip, and raise your straight arm up towards your left shoulder.
At shoulder height pause for a moment.
With a controlled movement resist the weight and slowly lower your arm back to starting position at your waist.
Repeat the exercise with your right arm.
cues: Maintain a good posture at all times during this exercise ensuring not swaying or arching at your back.
Do not perform this exercise if you have shoulder pain.

Plate Front Raise.setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a weight plate at the sides with both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions and arms straight in front of your thighs.
steps: Brace your core and keep your knees soft.
Raise the plate in front of you with arms nearly straight.
Stop when your hands reach about eye level.
Pause briefly, then lower the plate slowly to your thighs.
Keep your torso still for every rep.

Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding light dumbbells, hinge forward until your torso is near parallel to the floor, back flat, arms hanging below your chest.
steps: Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your neck neutral.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc.
Lift until your arms are about level with your torso and squeeze for a second.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back to the start.
Hold the same hinge angle throughout.
mistakes: Swinging the torso up and down
Using weights that are too heavy

Cable Rear Delt Fly.setup: Set two cable handles at shoulder height, cross the cables, and hold each handle with the opposite hand, standing back from the stack with arms forward and a soft bend in the elbows.
steps: Brace your core and set your shoulder blades gently down and back.
Pull the handles apart in a wide arc until your arms are out to your sides.
Squeeze your rear shoulders for a second at the end.
Return the handles slowly until your arms are in front again.
Keep tension on the cables between reps.
mistakes: Rowing the elbows too far behind
Letting the stack rest each rep

Meadows Row.setup: Set one end of a barbell in a landmine base or corner, stand side-on to the bar with feet staggered, hinge forward, and grip the thick end of the bar with one hand, free hand on your thigh.
steps: Hinge until your torso is about 45 degrees with a flat back.
Pull the bar toward your hip, driving your elbow up and back.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arm is straight.
Finish all reps on one side, then switch.

Single-Arm Cable Row.setup: Attach a single handle to a low or mid-height cable, sit or stand facing the stack, and hold the handle with one arm extended and your torso upright.
steps: Brace your core and set your shoulder down away from your ear.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, leading with your elbow.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back at the end of the pull.
Let your arm extend slowly until you feel a stretch in your back.
Finish all reps on one side, then switch.

Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown.setup: Sit at the pulldown station with thighs snug under the pads and grip the bar with hands wider than your shoulders and palms facing away, arms extended.
steps: Lean back slightly and lift your chest toward the bar.
Pull your elbows down and toward your sides until the bar reaches your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats for a second at the bottom.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are fully straight.
Keep your torso angle steady on every rep.
mistakes: Pulling the bar behind the neck
Swinging the torso back and forth

Neutral-Grip Pull-up.setup: Grasp the bar with an supinated (overhand) grip so that your palms are facing.
steps: Let your body hang from the bar with your arms straight.
Slowly pull yourself up so that your chin is higher than the bar.
With a controlled movement lower yourself to the starting position.
Repeat.
cues: Ensure that your body remains in one line throughout this exercise.

Assisted Chin-up.setup: Set the assist weight, kneel or stand on the pad, and grip the bar with hands shoulder-width apart and palms facing you, arms straight.
steps: Brace your core and pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
Pull your chest toward the bar, driving your elbows down and back.
Raise until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are fully straight.
Keep your legs still and avoid kicking.
mistakes: Craning the neck to reach the bar

Weighted Chin-up.setup: Attach a belt with a weight plate or hold a dumbbell between your feet, then grip the bar shoulder-width apart with palms facing you and arms fully straight.
steps: Brace your core and pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
Pull your chest toward the bar, driving your elbows down and back.
Raise until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are fully straight.
Let the weight settle before you begin the next rep.
mistakes: Adding load before clean bodyweight reps

Belt Squat.setup: Stand on the machine's platforms with the belt secured snugly around your hips, feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly, and the load released.
steps: Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips down between your knees until your thighs reach parallel or lower.
Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Stand tall without locking your knees hard at the top.

Trap Bar Deadlift.setup: Stand inside the trap bar with feet hip-width apart, hinge down and grip the handles with arms straight, hips lower than shoulders and back flat.
steps: Take a big breath and brace your core hard.
Push the floor away with your legs while keeping the bar close to you.
Stand fully upright by driving your hips forward at the top.
Reverse the movement by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Set the bar down on the floor under control before the next rep.

Reverse Lunge.setup: This is an advanced version of a lunge.
steps: Grasp a dumbbell in each hand.
Stand with your feet approximately 8 inches apart with your toes pointing forward.
Slowly take a step backward with your right leg.
Keeping your abs drawn in and your upper body straight, lower your body until your left knee is almost on the ground. You may choose to place a mat or towel under your knee.
Hold for a moment and then return to starting position.

Cable Kickback.setup: Standing at a cable tower attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley.
steps: Facing the weight stack, with a slight bend in your knees and your abs drawn in.
Slowly kick your ankle back in and arc as high as you are able to.
Return to starting position and switch ankles.

Barbell Glute Bridge.setup: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart, with a padded barbell rolled over your hips and held with both hands.
steps: Brace your core and tuck your ribs down.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body is a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes hard for a second at the top.
Lower your hips slowly until they almost touch the floor.
Keep your chin tucked and your feet planted for every rep.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top
Feet too far from or too close to the hips
Letting the bar roll toward your belly

Dumbbell Glute Bridge.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart, and rest a dumbbell across your hips, holding it steady with both hands.
steps: Brace your core and tuck your ribs down.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes hard for a second at the top.
Lower your hips slowly until they nearly touch the floor.
Keep your feet flat and your chin slightly tucked for every rep.
cues: Squeeze the glutes at the top

Dumbbell Hip Thrust.setup: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, knees bent and feet flat, and rest a dumbbell across your hips held with both hands.
steps: Tuck your chin and set your shoulder blades against the bench edge.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top with shins near vertical.
Lower your hips under control until they nearly touch the floor.
Keep your ribs down and your eyes ahead on every rep.

Smith Machine Hip Thrust.setup: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench in front of a Smith machine, bar padded and rolled over your hips, knees bent and feet flat.
steps: Unhook the bar and set your shoulder blades on the bench edge.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top with shins near vertical.
Lower your hips slowly until they nearly touch the floor.
Rehook the bar safely when your set is done.
mistakes: Hyperextending the lower back at the top
Feet too close to the hips

Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift.setup: Stand inside the Smith machine with feet hip-width apart, holding the bar at hip height with an overhand grip, knees soft and chest up.
steps: Unhook the bar and brace your core.
Push your hips straight back and slide the bar down your thighs.
Stop when you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings, with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up, squeezing your glutes.
Keep the knee bend the same on every rep.
mistakes: Standing too far under the bar

Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with palms facing you, knees soft and chest up.
steps: Brace your core and set your shoulder blades back.
Push your hips straight back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Lower until you feel a deep hamstring stretch, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, squeezing your glutes.
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs the whole time.
mistakes: Bending the knees into a squat

Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands in front of your thighs, knees soft and chest up.
steps: Brace your core and pull your shoulders back.
Push your hips straight back and slide the kettlebell down your shins.
Lower until you feel a deep hamstring stretch, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, squeezing your glutes.
Keep the kettlebell close to your legs throughout.

Machine Glute Kickback.setup: Stand facing the machine with your chest on the support pad, hold the handles, and place one foot against the pedal with your knee slightly bent.
steps: Brace your core and keep your hips square to the machine.
Press your foot back and up by squeezing your glute.
Stop when your hip is fully extended, without arching your back.
Hold the squeeze for a second, then return slowly.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch.
cues: Squeeze the glute, not the back
mistakes: Arching the lower back to kick higher

Cable Standing Hip Abduction.setup: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable, strap it to your outside ankle, and stand side-on to the stack holding a support, with the working leg away from the stack.
steps: Stand tall and brace your core.
Lift your working leg out to the side with your toes pointing forward.
Raise it until you feel your outer glute working, without leaning.
Pause briefly, then lower the leg slowly.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch.

Cable Standing Hip Adduction.setup: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable, strap it to your inside ankle, and stand side-on to the stack holding a support, with the working leg closest to the stack.
steps: Stand tall and brace your core.
Sweep your working leg across in front of your standing leg.
Squeeze your inner thigh at the end of the movement.
Return the leg slowly until your foot is back out to the side.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch.

Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat.setup: Stand a long stride in front of a bench inside a Smith machine, bar across your upper back, with your back foot resting on the bench and your front foot flat.
steps: Unhook the bar and brace your core.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your front heel down and your torso tall.
Drive through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish all reps on one leg, rehook the bar, then switch.
mistakes: Front foot too close to the bar line

Smith Machine Reverse Lunge.setup: Stand upright inside a Smith machine with the bar across your upper back, feet hip-width apart, and a step ahead of the bar line.
steps: Unhook the bar and brace your core.
Step one leg back and lower until your back knee is just above the floor.
Keep your front shin near vertical and your torso tall.
Drive through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish one side, then rehook the bar when done.
mistakes: Short steps that jam the knee forward

Smith Machine Split Squat.setup: Stand in a staggered stance inside a Smith machine with the bar across your upper back, front foot flat and back heel raised, feet about hip-width apart.
steps: Unhook the bar and brace your core.
Lower straight down until your back knee is just above the floor.
Keep your front heel down and your torso tall.
Drive through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish all reps on one leg, rehook the bar, then switch.

Heel-Elevated Goblet Squat.setup: Stand with your heels on a small plate or wedge and feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
steps: Brace your core and keep your elbows pointing down.
Sit your hips down between your knees while your knees travel forward over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are below parallel with your chest tall.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep the dumbbell against your chest throughout.

Dumbbell Sumo Squat.setup: Stand with feet wider than your shoulders and toes turned out about 45 degrees, holding one dumbbell vertically in front of you with both hands, arms straight.
steps: Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips straight down while your knees track over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to stand.
Keep the dumbbell close to your body throughout.

Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift.setup: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell vertically between your legs with both hands, arms straight, hips back and chest up.
steps: Brace your core and set your back flat.
Push the floor away with your legs and drive your hips forward.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes at the top.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower the dumbbell.
Keep the dumbbell close to your body on every rep.

Front-Foot Elevated Split Squat.setup: Place your front foot on a low plate or step, hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, and set your back foot a long stride behind with the heel raised.
steps: Brace your core and keep your torso tall.
Lower straight down until your back knee is just above the floor.
Keep your front foot flat with your knee over your toes.
Drive through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch.
mistakes: Short stance that jams the knee

Deficit Reverse Lunge.setup: Stand on a low plate or step with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, feet hip-width apart, with space behind you to step back.
steps: Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Step one leg back, off the platform, and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your front shin near vertical and your weight on your front heel.
Drive through your front foot to return to the platform.
Alternate legs or finish one side, then switch.

Dumbbell Lateral Lunge.setup: Stand tall with feet together, holding a dumbbell at your chest in both hands or one dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
steps: Step wide to one side and plant that foot flat with toes forward.
Push your hips back and bend that knee while keeping the other leg straight.
Lower until your thigh is about parallel to the floor with your chest up.
Push through your bent leg to return to standing.
Alternate sides or finish one side, then switch.
mistakes: Heel lifting on the working side

Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell at your chest in both hands or one in each hand at your sides.
steps: Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Step one leg back and across behind the other, like a curtsy.
Lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, with hips square.
Drive through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish one side, then switch.
mistakes: Stepping too narrow and losing balance

Landmine Squat.setup: Stand facing the anchored bar end, hold it against your chest with both hands, feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Brace your core and keep your elbows tucked in close.
Sit your hips down and back while your knees track over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your whole foot to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top before the next rep.
mistakes: Letting the bar drift away from your chest

Landmine Romanian Deadlift.setup: Stand beside the anchored bar end, holding it in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart with a soft bend in your knees.
steps: Brace your core and pull your shoulders down and back.
Push your hips straight back and slide the bar down your thighs.
Lower until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings, back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to drive your hips forward.
Stand tall without leaning back.
mistakes: Bending the knees into a squat

Kettlebell Swing.setup: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders, the kettlebell on the floor a step in front of you.
steps: Hinge at your hips and grab the handle with both hands, back flat.
Hike the bell back between your thighs like a football snap.
Snap your hips forward hard to stand tall and float the bell to chest height.
Let the bell fall while pushing your hips back, arms staying loose.
Hike it back again and repeat in a steady rhythm.
mistakes: Squatting the swing instead of hinging
Lifting the bell with your arms

Glute-Focused Back Extension.setup: Set the pad just below your hips on a back extension bench, feet anchored, body in a line from head to heels.
steps: Cross your arms over your chest and round your upper back slightly.
Bend forward at the hips, lowering your torso under control.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to raise your torso back to a straight line.
Pause briefly at the top without arching.
mistakes: Hyperextending your lower back at the top

Reverse Hyperextension.setup: Lie face down on the machine pad with your hips at the edge, hold the handles, and let your legs hang.
steps: Brace your core and hold the handles firmly.
Squeeze your glutes to swing your legs up until they line up with your body.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower your legs slowly under control.
Keep the swing smooth and avoid bouncing at the bottom.
mistakes: Lifting your chest off the pad

Donkey Calf Raise.setup: This is an old school gym exercise which requires the assistance of another person. This is an advanced exercise and not recommended for beginners.
steps: Bend your waist and lean your arms against a weight rack or bench that is waist height.
Have a partner sit on top of your lower back.
Raise up on your toes leaning slightly forward.
Pause at the top and then lower your heels to the floor.
Note: Have a Personal Trainer or Instructor show you how to perform this exercise safely.

Leg Press Calf Raise.setup: This exercise uses a Leg Press Machine to work your calves. You can perform this exercise along with Leg Presses.
steps: Sit down on a Leg Press Machine and press the plate up as if you were performing a leg press.
Slide your feet down so that the balls of your feet are pressing against the rack (with your heels hanging free).
Keeping the handles locked, press up and flex your toes and then slowly bring your toes back towards your body.
Perform theses movements slowly for maximum benefit.
Note: Use a lighter weight on this exercise than you are able to lift with a leg press until you are familiar with the movements.

Wall Sit.setup: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your feet about two feet out, hip-width apart.
steps: Slide your back down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Place your knees directly over your ankles at about 90 degrees.
Press your lower back and shoulders into the wall.
Rest your hands on your thighs or hold them out in front of you.
Hold for 30 to 60 seconds, breathing steadily, then slide up to stand.
mistakes: Pushing down on your thighs with your hands

Jump Squat.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms bent in front of your chest.
steps: Sit your hips back and down into a quarter to half squat.
Swing your arms back and then drive them up as you explode upward.
Jump as high as you can, extending your hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink straight into the next squat.
Reset your balance for a moment if needed before each jump.

Incline Dumbbell Curl.setup: Adjust an incline bench to a 45 degree angle.
steps: Grasp a dumbbell in each hand and sit back on the bench with your feet firmly planted on the floor.
Allow your arms to hang down at your sides.
Keeping your elbow straight, raise your right arm up towards your head.
In a controlled manner lower the weight and repeat with your left arm.

Concentration Curl.setup: Sit on the end of a flat bench with your feet flat and your legs spread apart.
steps: Grasp a dumbbell in your hand, palms facing up.
With your elbow pressed against your inner thigh, curl the dumbbell up towards your chest.
Slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat and switch arms.
Note: Keep all of your body still except the arm you are exercising.

EZ-Bar Curl.setup: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your knees slightly bent.
steps: Grasp the barbell with palms up.
Lower the bar so it is against your thighs.
Keeping your elbows still, raise the bar up to your chest so that your forearms touch your biceps.
Note: Lean up against a wall or post to keep yourself from swaying.

Spider Curl.setup: This exercise uses the straight side of a Preacher Curl bench to increase the range of motion of the exercise.
steps: Turn a Preacher Curl bench around so you are leaning against the angled side.
Grasp a barbell with palms up, approximately 6 inches apart.
Leaning against the bench, lower the bar along the flat side of the bench fully extending your arms.
Curl your arms up so your biceps are touching your forearms.
Slowly lower the bar to the starting position.
Note: Use a low weight to get used to the motion of this exercise.

Rope Hammer Curl.setup: Set up as the drawing shows, ready for the first rep.
steps: Using the rope with the cable machine allows you isolate the biceps with this version of the Hammer Curl. This is a good exercise for beginners.

Attach a rope to a cable pulley to the bottom of the weight stack. Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your knees slightly bent and your abs drawn in. Grasp the rope with a close underhand grip (palms facing up). Lower your arms fully to above your thighs and bending only your elbows, raise the rope to your upper chest. Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
Note: Keep your elbows at your side throughout this exercise. Do not swing your hips or back during this exercise.

Drag Curl.setup: This exercise is credited to the late Vince Gironda, the "Iron Guru". It not only blasts the biceps and works the forearms as well.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your knees slightly bent, and your abs drawn in.
Grasp the bar with palms down, shoulder width apart.
Extend your arms fully so they are against your thighs.
Slowly raise your arms, palms down, to touch your chest.
Note: Do not move your elbows or shoulders during this exercise.

Rope Triceps Pushdown.setup: Stand in front of a cable machine and attach a rope to a high pulley.
steps: Grasp the rope with palms facing down.
Draw your abs in and keep your back straight.
Keeping your elbows at your side push the rope down towards your thighs, if possible "split" the rope apart at the bottom.
Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
Note: You may want to stager one foot in front of the other for a better stance.

Two Dumbbell Skullcrusher.setup: Lay on a flat bench with your head at one end and your feet planted firmly on the floor.
steps: Grasp a dumbbell with both hands with palms facing up.
Raise dumbbell over your body. Your arms will be pointed towards the ceiling.
While keeping your upper arms and elbows still, lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head.
Slowly raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.

One-Arm Dumbbell Skull Crusher.setup: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell straight above your shoulder, palm facing in, other hand resting on your chest.
steps: Keep your upper arm vertical and elbow pointing at the ceiling.
Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell toward the side of your head.
Stop when your forearm is just past parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your triceps to straighten your arm back to the start.
Finish all reps on one arm, then switch.
mistakes: Using too much weight and swinging
Dropping the dumbbell too close to your face

Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension.setup: Sit on a short, straight backed bench with your feet planted firmly on the floor.
steps: Drawing your abs in, grasp the dumbbell with both hands with a palms up grip.
Raise the weight over your head, this is your starting position.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc from above your head to behind your back.
Slowly return to the starting position.

One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension.setup: Sit or stand tall holding one dumbbell overhead with your arm straight and your palm facing forward.
steps: Brace your core and keep your upper arm close to your head.
Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your triceps.
Straighten your arm to press the dumbbell back overhead.
Finish all reps on one arm, then switch.
mistakes: Letting the weight drop too fast

Wrist Extension.setup: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh or a bench, palm down, holding a light dumbbell with your wrist hanging past the edge.
steps: Let the dumbbell lower by bending your wrist toward the floor.
Keep your forearm flat and still on the support.
Lift the dumbbell by bending your wrist up as far as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch arms.
mistakes: Lifting your forearm off the support

Crunch.setup: This is the most common abdominal exercise and possibly the most often improperly performed. Here is how to perform it correctly.
steps: Lie on your back with your feet up on a bench and your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.
Place your hands across your chest or on either side of your head (over your ears).
Raise your head, shoulders and chest off the floor and towards your knees, crunching your abs.
Hold the position for a moment and then lower to the starting position.
Note: Keep your hips straight and your lower back against the floor during this exercise.

Reverse Crunch.setup: Lie on your back with your arms outstretched to your sides.
steps: Bend your knees at a 60 degree angle and hold your feet up just off the floor.
Keeping your back and arms down, raise your hips up and off the floor so that your knees are over your chest.
Contract your abs for a moment and then return to the starting position.

Russian Twist.setup: Sit on the floor with knees bent, heels down, and lean back until your torso is at about 45 degrees, hands clasped in front of you.
steps: Brace your core and keep your chest lifted.
Rotate your torso to one side, moving your hands with you.
Pause briefly at the end of the turn.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Keep the pace steady and controlled.
mistakes: Letting your feet and hips flop around

Bicycle Crunch.setup: This exercise works your abs by raising your arms to meet your legs. The movements are similar to riding a bike.
steps: Lie on your back on a mat.
Place your hands on either side of your head (over your ears).
Raise your legs up, bending your knees and keeping your calves parallel to the floor.
Bring your left arm elbow up to meet your right knee, as if riding a bike.
Repeat with your right elbow and left knee.
Continue alternating sides.
Note: Move your arms across your chest, squeezing your abs as you move.

Mountain Climber.setup: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
steps: Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly, driving the other knee forward.
Keep your shoulders over your hands as you alternate.
Work at a fast but controlled pace for 30 to 45 seconds.
mistakes: Hands drifting forward of the shoulders

Bird Dog.setup: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips, back flat.
steps: Brace your core and keep your spine neutral.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg straight back at the same time.
Hold for two seconds with your hips level.
Return slowly to the start without shifting your weight.
Repeat on the other side, alternating.

Half-Kneeling Pallof Press.setup: Kneel on the leg nearest the cable with the other foot forward, holding the handle at your chest with both hands.
steps: Square your hips and ribs forward and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out in front of your chest.
Pause for a second with your arms fully extended.
Pull it slowly back to your chest.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

Cable Pallof Hold.setup: Stand sideways to the cable with feet hip-width apart, holding the handle at your chest with both hands.
steps: Take a step away from the stack so the cable is under tension.
Press the handle straight out until your arms are extended.
Brace your core and resist any twisting toward the cable.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Bring the handle back to your chest and switch sides.

Captain's Chair Knee Raise.setup: Support your forearms on the pads with your back against the backrest and your legs hanging straight down.
steps: Brace your core and press your back into the pad.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Curl your pelvis up slightly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly until they hang again.
Avoid swinging between reps.
mistakes: Only lifting with your hip flexors

Decline Sit-Up.setup: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back with your knees bent and arms crossed over your chest.
steps: Brace your core and tuck your chin slightly.
Curl your torso up, one section of your spine at a time.
Sit up until your chest is above your knees.
Lower back down slowly with control.
Stop just before your back touches the bench for constant tension.
mistakes: Using momentum to throw yourself up

Weighted Crunch.setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, holding a plate against your chest.
steps: Brace your core and keep your lower back pressed down.
Curl your ribs toward your hips, lifting your shoulder blades off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly until your shoulders touch the floor.
Keep the plate held close to your chest throughout.
mistakes: Using a plate that is too heavy

Weighted Russian Twist.setup: Sit on the floor with knees bent and heels down, leaning back about 45 degrees, holding one dumbbell with both hands at your chest.
steps: Brace your core and keep your chest lifted.
Rotate your torso to one side, carrying the dumbbell with you.
Touch the dumbbell near the floor beside your hip.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Keep the pace steady and controlled.

Dumbbell Side Bend.setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, one dumbbell in your hand at your side and the other hand resting on your hip.
steps: Brace your core and keep your shoulders square.
Bend sideways from your waist, lowering the dumbbell toward your knee.
Go as far as you can without leaning forward or back.
Use your side abs to pull yourself back upright.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

Treadmill Incline Walk.setup: Stand on the treadmill with the incline set to 8 to 12 percent and a comfortable walking speed, hands off the rails.
steps: Start the belt at a slow warm-up pace for the first couple of minutes.
Walk at 3 to 3.5 mph (about 5 km/h), keeping a steady pace.
Stand tall with your chest up and a slight lean from the ankles.
Swing your arms naturally and take full steps through your glutes.
Continue for 20 to 30 minutes, then lower the incline and slow down for a cool-down.
cues: Tall chest, light touch on the rails
mistakes: Setting the speed too fast to hold form

Battle Ropes.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in a quarter squat, holding one rope end in each hand with arms in front of you.
steps: Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Raise one arm and snap it down to make a wave in the rope.
Alternate arms quickly to keep the waves going.
Keep your knees soft and your hips steady.
Work hard for 20 to 30 seconds, rest 30 to 60 seconds, and repeat.
mistakes: Standing too upright with locked knees

Knee Push-up.setup: Start on your hands and knees with hands slightly wider than your shoulders, body in a line from head to knees.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows about 45 degrees from your sides.
Stop when your chest is just above the floor.
Press the floor away to straighten your arms.
Keep your hips in line with your shoulders and knees.

Wide Push-up.setup: Place your hands well wider than your shoulders and stand on your toes, body in one straight line.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lower your chest toward the floor, letting your elbows flare slightly.
Stop when your chest is just above the floor.
Press up to straighten your arms.
Keep your neck neutral and gaze slightly ahead.
mistakes: Going too wide for your shoulders

Decline Push-up.setup: Place your feet on a bench or sturdy step and your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders, body in one straight line.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows about 45 degrees from your sides.
Stop with your chest just above the floor.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body rigid the whole time.

Feet-Elevated Pike Push-up.setup: Place your feet on a bench or step and your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart, hips high so your body forms an inverted V.
steps: Brace your core and look toward your feet.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands.
Stop just before your head touches the floor.
Press through your hands to push your hips back and up.
Keep your hips high throughout.
mistakes: Hips dropping into a regular push-up
Crashing your head into the floor

Typewriter Push-up.setup: Start in a wide push-up position with your hands well wider than your shoulders, body in one straight line.
steps: Brace your core and lower your chest toward your right hand, keeping your left arm straight.
Slide your chest across toward your left hand at the bottom.
Press up from the left side, straightening your bent arm.
Lower toward your left hand, shifting back across to the right.
Alternate sides each rep, keeping your hips low and level.

Explosive Push-up.setup: Place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and stand on your toes, body in one straight line.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lower your chest to just above the floor under control.
Push up as fast and hard as you can so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly with bent elbows and go straight into the next rep.
Stop the set when your push becomes slow, not sloppy.
mistakes: Doing it while tired and sloppy

Hindu Push-up.setup: Start in a pike position with your feet wide, hips high, and hands shoulder-width apart.
steps: Bend your elbows and dive your chest forward and down toward the floor.
Sweep your chest forward and up into an upward-facing dog, hips low.
Press back by pushing your hips up and back to the pike position.
Reverse the path to return, keeping your motion smooth.
Keep your breathing steady and your feet planted.

Push-up Shoulder Tap.setup: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and feet slightly wider than hip-width apart.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return that hand to the floor under your shoulder.
Tap with the other hand.
Keep your hips from rocking side to side throughout.

Wall Push-up.setup: Stand an arm's length from a wall and place your hands on it at chest height, slightly wider than your shoulders.
steps: Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Keep your elbows about 45 degrees from your sides.
Stop when your nose is close to the wall.
Press back to straighten your arms.

Wall Walk.setup: Lie face down with your feet against a wall and your hands on the floor under your shoulders in a plank position.
steps: Brace your core and walk your feet up the wall.
Walk your hands back toward the wall in small steps.
Stop when your chest is close to the wall and your body is nearly vertical.
Hold for a moment, then walk your hands forward.
Lower your feet back to the floor under control.
mistakes: Taking steps that are too big

Towel Row.setup: Loop a towel around a sturdy post or closed door handle, hold both ends, and lean back with your arms straight.
steps: Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the towel, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Hold for one second.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

Prone T Raise.setup: Lie face down on the floor with your arms out to the sides in a T and your thumbs pointing up.
steps: Rest your forehead lightly on the floor and brace your core.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your arms off the floor as high as you comfortably can.
Hold for one to two seconds.
Lower your arms slowly and repeat.

Superman.setup: Lie face down with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead, forehead resting on the floor.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few inches off the floor.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Hold for two seconds at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
mistakes: Lifting too high into your lower back

Reverse Snow Angel.setup: Lie face down with your arms by your sides, palms down, forehead hovering just off the floor.
steps: Lift your chest and arms a few inches off the floor.
Sweep your straight arms out and up in a wide arc toward overhead.
Keep your thumbs pointing up as the arms pass shoulder height.
Reverse the arc back to your sides without letting your arms touch down.
Lower your chest to the floor only after the last rep.

Commando Pull-up.setup: Stand under the bar and grip it with one hand in front of the other, palms facing each other, body hanging straight.
steps: Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull up until your head passes to one side of the bar.
Lower under control to a full hang.
Pull up again with your head passing the other side of the bar.
Swap your hand positions halfway through your reps.

Towel Pull-up.setup: Drape a towel over the bar, hold an end in each hand, and hang with arms straight.
steps: Squeeze the towel ends firmly and pull your shoulder blades down.
Drive your elbows toward your ribs and pull your chin above your hands.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.
Keep your legs still or crossed behind you throughout.

Forward Lunge.setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips or clasped at your chest.
steps: Step forward with one foot into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees and the back knee hovers near the floor.
Keep your front knee over your mid-foot and your torso upright.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Repeat on the other leg or finish all reps on one side first.

Lateral Lunge.setup: Stand tall with feet together and hands clasped at your chest.
steps: Take a big step out to one side.
Push your hips back and bend the stepping knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep both feet flat and toes pointing forward.
Sink until your thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push off the bent leg to return to standing, then repeat on the other side.
mistakes: Knee drifting past the toes sideways

Curtsy Lunge.setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped at your chest.
steps: Shift your weight onto one leg.
Step the other foot back and across behind you, like a curtsy.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your hips square and chest tall.
Push through the front foot to return to standing, then repeat on the other side.

Skater Squat.setup: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent behind you and arms out in front for balance.
steps: Hinge your hips back and bend the standing knee.
Lower until your rear knee lightly taps or hovers just above the floor.
Swing your arms forward to stay balanced.
Keep the standing foot flat and your chest lifted.
Drive up through the standing heel, then finish all reps before switching legs.

Single-Leg Box Squat.setup: Sit tall on the front edge of a box, one foot flat in front of you and the other leg held out straight.
steps: Lean slightly forward and press your standing foot into the floor.
Stand up on one leg without pushing off the box with your hands.
Pause upright with your hips fully extended.
Sit back slowly, touching the box lightly to control the depth.
Stand again straight away, finishing all reps before switching legs.

Step-Down.setup: Stand on the edge of a box on one foot, the other foot hanging off the side and your hands on your hips.
steps: Brace your core and shift your weight onto the standing leg.
Slowly bend the standing knee and lower the free heel toward the floor.
Tap the floor lightly with your heel without putting weight on it.
Push through the box foot to stand tall again.
Finish all reps before switching legs.

Calf Raise.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart, toes forward, balls of your feet on the floor or a low step.
steps: Press through the balls of your feet and rise as high as you can.
Pause for one second at the top.
Lower your heels slowly past the starting height if you are on a step.
Keep your knees straight but not locked.
Repeat for smooth, controlled reps.

Glute Bridge March.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat hip-width apart and arms by your sides.
steps: Press through your heels and lift your hips into a bridge.
Hold the bridge and lift one foot slightly off the floor, bringing the knee toward your chest.
Place that foot down without letting your hips sag.
Lift the other foot in the same way.
Alternate sides, then lower your hips after the last rep.

Frog Pump.setup: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together, knees wide, and heels close to your hips.
steps: Brace your core and press your feet together.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top with your ribs down and hips fully extended.
Lower your hips just above the floor.
Repeat with quick, controlled reps.

Donkey Kick.setup: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders, knees under hips, and your back flat.
steps: Brace your core to keep your spine still.
Keep your knee bent at 90 degrees and lift one foot toward the ceiling.
Stop when your thigh is in line with your back.
Squeeze your glute for a beat at the top.
Lower with control and finish all reps before switching legs.

Fire Hydrant.setup: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders, knees under hips, and your back flat.
steps: Brace your core and keep your weight even.
Lift one knee out to the side, keeping it bent at 90 degrees.
Raise it to about hip height without rotating your torso.
Pause briefly and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly and finish all reps before switching sides.

Clamshell.setup: Lie on your side with knees bent about 45 degrees, feet together, and your head resting on your arm.
steps: Stack your hips and brace your core so the pelvis does not roll back.
Keep your feet touching and lift your top knee as far as you can.
Pause and squeeze the side of your hip.
Lower your knee slowly back to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

Hip Airplane.setup: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, hinged forward with your torso, and your hands out for balance.
steps: Hinge forward until your torso is near parallel to the floor, with the other leg extended behind.
Rotate your chest and hips open toward the side of the standing leg.
Rotate them back to face the floor.
Move slowly for 5 to 8 rotations in each direction.
Switch legs and repeat, breathing steadily throughout.
mistakes: Letting the standing knee cave in

Side-Lying Leg Raise.setup: Lie on your side with legs straight and stacked, your bottom arm supporting your head.
steps: Brace your core and keep your hips stacked.
Point your toes forward and lift your top leg about 12 to 18 inches.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower the leg slowly without touching the other foot.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
mistakes: Lifting the toes toward the ceiling

Lying Hamstring Walkout.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat, and hips lifted into a bridge.
steps: Squeeze your glutes to hold your hips high.
Walk your feet slowly away from you, one small step at a time.
Stop when you cannot keep your hips lifted.
Walk your feet back in the same way.
Lower your hips only after the last rep.
mistakes: Hips sagging as feet go out

Towel Hamstring Curl.setup: Lie on your back with your heels on a towel on a smooth floor, knees bent and hips lifted in a bridge.
steps: Press your heels into the towel and lift your hips.
Slide your heels away until your legs are almost straight.
Keep your hips lifted and in line with your torso.
Pull your heels back toward your hips with your hamstrings.
Lower your hips after the last rep.

Stability Ball Hamstring Curl.setup: Lie on your back with your heels on top of a stability ball, legs straight and hips lifted.
steps: Press your heels into the ball and lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Bend your knees and roll the ball toward your hips.
Keep your hips lifted and pelvis level.
Extend your legs slowly to roll the ball back out.
Lower your hips after the last rep.

Banded Glute Bridge.setup: Lie on your back with a band above your knees, feet flat hip-width apart, and arms at your sides.
steps: Press your knees gently outward against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Pause at the top with your glutes squeezed.
Lower your hips slowly toward the floor.
Keep tension on the band throughout every rep.

Banded Hip Thrust.setup: Sit with your upper back against a bench, a band above your knees, and your feet flat hip-width apart.
steps: Press your knees outward against the band and tuck your chin.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for one second.
Lower your hips under control.
Keep your shins roughly vertical at the top.
mistakes: Feet too far forward or back

Banded Frog Pump.setup: Lie on your back with a band above your knees, soles of your feet together, and knees wide.
steps: Press your knees outward against the band.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your hips just above the floor.
Repeat with controlled, steady reps.

Banded Clamshell.setup: Lie on your side with a band above your knees, knees bent about 45 degrees and feet together.
steps: Stack your hips and brace your core.
Keep your feet together and lift your top knee against the band.
Pause at the top and squeeze the side of your hip.
Lower slowly without letting the band snap back.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

Banded Lateral Walk.setup: Stand with a band above your knees, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent in a quarter squat.
steps: Keep your chest up and toes forward.
Step sideways with your lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring your trailing foot in until feet are hip-width apart again.
Take 10 to 15 steps in one direction.
Walk back the other way without standing up out of your squat.
mistakes: Rocking the torso side to side

Banded Monster Walk.setup: Stand with a band above your knees or around your ankles, feet shoulder-width apart, in a quarter squat.
steps: Keep your chest up and your knees pushed out against the band.
Step forward and slightly out to the side with one foot.
Step the other foot forward and out in the same way.
Keep your feet wider than hip width the whole time.
Take 10 to 15 steps forward, then walk backward the same way.

Banded Squat.setup: Stand with a band above your knees, feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out, and hands clasped at your chest.
steps: Push your knees out against the band.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest tall and heels flat.
Drive through your whole foot to stand.
Keep the band tight on every rep.

Banded Donkey Kick.setup: Start on hands and knees with a band around your feet or above your knees, back flat.
steps: Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Keep your knee bent and press one foot up toward the ceiling against the band.
Stop when your thigh is in line with your back.
Squeeze your glute for a beat.
Lower slowly and finish all reps before switching legs.

Banded Fire Hydrant.setup: Start on hands and knees with a band above your knees, hands under shoulders, back flat.
steps: Brace your core and keep your weight even.
Lift one knee out to the side against the band, keeping it bent at 90 degrees.
Raise it to about hip height without turning your torso.
Pause and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly and finish all reps before switching sides.

Banded Kickback.setup: Stand facing a sturdy anchor with a band looped around your ankle, hands on the anchor for balance, slight knee bend.
steps: Brace your core and stand tall.
Keep your leg nearly straight and kick it back behind you.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish all reps before switching legs.

Banded Standing Hip Abduction.setup: Stand tall with a band above your knees or around your ankles, holding a wall or support for balance.
steps: Shift your weight onto your standing leg with a soft knee.
Lift your other leg out to the side with toes forward.
Stop when you feel your hip working, before your torso leans.
Pause, then return slowly against the band.
Finish all reps before switching legs.
mistakes: Leaning away from the lifting leg

Banded Seated Hip Abduction.setup: Sit tall on a bench or chair with a band above your knees, feet flat and knees together.
steps: Brace your core and sit upright.
Push your knees apart against the band as far as you can.
Squeeze the sides of your hips at the widest point.
Hold for one second.
Bring your knees back together slowly.

Band Pull-Apart.setup: Stand tall holding a band in front of you at chest height, arms straight, hands shoulder-width apart.
steps: Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Stop when the band touches your chest or your arms are fully wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together for a second.
Let the band come back slowly to the start.

Banded Face Pull.setup: Anchor a band at about face height, hold an end in each hand, and step back until there is tension, arms straight.
steps: Stand tall with your knees slightly bent and core tight.
Pull the band toward your face, leading with your hands.
Flare your elbows high and out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Return to the start slowly with straight arms.

Banded Row.setup: Sit on the floor with legs out and a band looped around your feet, holding an end in each hand, arms straight.
steps: Sit tall and brace your core.
Pull your elbows back along your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Pause for a second.
Return your hands forward slowly until your arms are straight.

Banded Lat Pulldown.setup: Anchor a band above your head, kneel or sit facing it, and hold an end in each hand with arms overhead, wider than your shoulders.
steps: Sit tall with your chest lifted and core braced.
Pull your elbows down and toward your ribs.
Bring your hands to about chin or upper chest height.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let your arms rise slowly back overhead.
mistakes: Letting the band yank your arms up

Banded Pallof Press.setup: Anchor the band at chest height beside you, stand side-on with feet hip-width apart, and hold the band with both hands at your chest.
steps: Step away from the anchor until the band has firm tension and brace your core.
Press your hands straight out in front of your chest until your arms are fully extended.
Hold for a second while resisting the band's pull to rotate you.
Bring your hands back to your chest under control.
Finish all reps, then turn around and repeat on the other side.

Banded Woodchop.setup: Anchor the band high, stand side-on with feet wider than hips, and hold the band with both hands near the anchor-side shoulder.
steps: Step out until the band is taut and brace your core.
Pull the band diagonally down across your body toward the opposite hip.
Pivot your back foot and turn your torso as your arms extend.
Return slowly along the same diagonal to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
mistakes: Letting the band snap you back

Banded Dead Bug.setup: Lie on your back holding a band taut overhead with both hands, hips and knees bent to 90 degrees with shins parallel to the floor.
steps: Press your lower back gently into the floor and brace your core.
Extend one leg out straight while keeping your arms pulling the band apart.
Stop just above the floor without your lower back lifting.
Return the leg to 90 degrees.
Repeat with the other leg, alternating sides each rep.
mistakes: Lower back arching off the floor

Hollow Rock.setup: Lie on your back with arms stretched overhead and legs straight, then lift your shoulders and legs off the floor into a hollow shape.
steps: Press your lower back into the floor and tuck your ribs down.
Hold your arms by your ears and your legs low, with the whole body in a shallow curve.
Rock back so your upper back touches down while holding the curve.
Rock forward until your lower back is just about to lift.
Keep rocking smoothly, never relaxing the shape.
mistakes: Letting arms or legs drop out of shape

V-Up.setup: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and arms extended overhead.
steps: Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your legs and torso at the same time, reaching your hands toward your toes.
Reach the top with your body in a V shape.
Lower your arms and legs slowly together.
Stop just above the floor and go into the next rep.

Flutter Kick.setup: Lie on your back with legs straight, hands under your hips, and lift your head and shoulders slightly with your lower back pressed down.
steps: Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick one leg up a short way while the other goes down.
Alternate legs in small, quick, steady kicks.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor throughout.
Continue for 30 to 45 seconds at a steady fast pace, then rest.

Toe Touch.setup: Lie on your back with legs pointing straight up and arms reaching toward your toes.
steps: Brace your core and keep your legs fixed in the air.
Curl your shoulders off the floor and reach your hands toward your toes.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your shoulders back down with control.
Keep your neck relaxed and repeat.

Plank Shoulder Tap.setup: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders and feet slightly wider than hip-width.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Place the hand back down with control.
Tap with the other hand.
Alternate sides while keeping your hips from rocking.

Plank Jack.setup: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders and feet together.
steps: Brace your core and keep your shoulders over your hands.
Jump both feet out wide at the same time.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level as you repeat at a steady pace.
Continue for 20 to 40 seconds, then rest.

Bear Plank.setup: Kneel on all fours with hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips, then tuck your toes.
steps: Press through your hands and spread your fingers.
Lift your knees about an inch off the floor.
Keep your back flat and your knees under your hips.
Brace your core and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20 to 40 seconds, then lower and rest.

Bear Crawl.setup: Start on all fours with hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips, and knees lifted just off the floor.
steps: Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Move your right hand and left foot forward together.
Move your left hand and right foot forward together.
Keep your knees low and your steps small.
Crawl for 20 to 30 seconds at a steady pace, then rest or crawl back.

Crab Walk.setup: Sit on the floor with knees bent, hands behind you, then lift your hips so your body forms a tabletop.
steps: Press through your hands and feet and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your hips high and your chest open.
Move your right hand and left foot a short step in one direction.
Follow with your left hand and right foot.
Walk for 20 to 30 seconds at a steady pace, then switch direction.

Inchworm.setup: Stand tall with feet about hip-width apart.
steps: Hinge forward and place your hands on the floor, bending your knees if needed.
Walk your hands forward until you reach a long plank position.
Hold for a moment with your core braced.
Walk your feet toward your hands in small steps.
Stand up tall and repeat.

Seated Knee Tuck.setup: Sit on the floor leaning back slightly with hands behind you, chest lifted, and legs extended with heels just off the floor.
steps: Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Pull your knees in toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top.
Extend your legs back out without touching the floor.
Repeat with a smooth, steady tempo.
mistakes: Letting the heels hit the floor

Side Plank Hip Dip.setup: Lie on your side and prop yourself on your forearm, elbow under your shoulder, feet stacked, hips lifted into a side plank.
steps: Brace your core and keep your body in one line.
Lower your bottom hip toward the floor.
Lift it back up past the starting height.
Keep your shoulder stacked over your elbow.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

Copenhagen Plank.setup: Set up in a side plank with your top leg resting on a bench or sturdy chair, forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
steps: Rest the inside of your top knee or ankle on the bench.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Lift your bottom leg to meet the top leg or let it hover beneath.
Breathe steadily and keep your hips from dropping.
Hold for 15 to 30 seconds, rest, then switch sides.
mistakes: Rotating the chest to the floor

Burpee.setup: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Jump or step your feet back into a high plank.
Lower your chest to the floor, then press back up.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Jump up with arms overhead and land softly.
mistakes: Rushing at the cost of form

High Knees.setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms bent at your sides.
steps: Run in place by driving one knee up toward hip height.
Pump your opposite arm as you switch legs.
Land on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest tall and core braced.
Continue for 20 to 40 seconds at a fast pace, then rest.

Jumping Jack.setup: Stand tall with feet together and arms at your sides.
steps: Jump your feet out wide while swinging your arms overhead.
Land softly with knees slightly bent.
Jump your feet back together as your arms return to your sides.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for 30 to 60 seconds at a moderate pace.

Lateral Shuffle.setup: Stand in a quarter squat with feet slightly wider than hip-width, chest up, and hands in front.
steps: Push off your trailing foot and step sideways.
Bring your other foot in without crossing your feet.
Stay low and keep your hips level.
Shuffle several steps one way, then reverse.
Continue for 20 to 30 seconds at a quick pace, then rest.

Sprawl.setup: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Drop your hands to the floor and kick your feet back quickly.
Let your hips drop toward the floor as your legs extend.
Snap your feet back under your hips into a squat.
Stand up with chest tall.
Reset and repeat at a quick pace.

Cat-Cow Stretch.setup: Kneel on all fours with hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
steps: Inhale and drop your belly while lifting your chest and tailbone.
Exhale and round your spine toward the ceiling, tucking your chin.
Move slowly through the full range of your spine.
Match each movement to one breath.
Continue for 8 to 10 slow breath cycles, about 45 to 60 seconds.

Arm Circles.setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms extended out to your sides at shoulder height.
steps: Brace your core and keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Draw small circles with both arms.
Gradually make the circles larger.
Do about 10 to 15 circles forward.
Reverse the direction for another 10 to 15 circles.

World's Greatest Stretch.setup: Start in a high plank position with hands under your shoulders.
steps: Step your right foot outside your right hand into a deep lunge.
Lower your inner forearm toward the floor or a comfortable height.
Rotate your chest toward the right and reach your right arm to the ceiling.
Hold for 2 to 3 breaths, then return the hand to the floor.
Step back to plank and repeat on the left side, doing 3 to 5 reps per side.
cues: Follow the hand with your eyes

Leg Swing Stretch.setup: Stand tall next to a wall or sturdy support, holding it with one hand.
steps: Brace your core and stand tall on one leg.
Swing your free leg forward and back in a controlled arc.
Gradually increase the range without arching your back.
Do 10 to 15 swings, then turn and swing the leg side to side.
Switch legs and repeat.
mistakes: Leaning forward and back with the swing

Torso Twist Stretch.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly soft, and arms bent in front of your chest.
steps: Brace your core and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to one side as far as is comfortable.
Return to center.
Rotate to the other side.
Continue for 30 to 45 seconds, breathing evenly.

Doorway Chest Stretch.setup: Stand in a doorway with your forearm on the frame, elbow bent to 90 degrees at shoulder height.
steps: Place your forearm and hand flat on the frame.
Step one foot through the doorway.
Gently lean forward until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch arms and repeat.

Child's Pose.setup: Kneel on the floor with your big toes touching and knees apart, sitting back on your heels.
steps: Fold forward and reach your arms out in front of you.
Rest your forehead on the floor.
Sink your hips back toward your heels.
Relax your shoulders and neck.
Hold for 30 to 60 seconds, about 5 to 8 slow breaths.

Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch.setup: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front, using a mat or pad under your back knee.
steps: Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze the glute on the back-leg side.
Keep your torso upright.
Shift your hips gently forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Hold for 30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch legs and repeat.
mistakes: Front knee going past the toes

Hamstring Stretch.setup: Sit or lie down comfortably, or stand with one heel resting on a low support, keeping the leg straight.
steps: Keep the stretching leg straight with your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch behind the thigh.
Hold for 30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch legs and repeat.

Standing Quad Stretch.setup: Stand tall, holding a wall or chair for balance if needed.
steps: Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glutes.
Hold your ankle with the same-side hand.
Keep your knees together and your hips tucked slightly under.
Hold for 30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch legs and repeat.

Seated Forward Fold.setup: Sit on the floor with legs straight out in front of you and toes pointing up.
steps: Sit tall and brace your core lightly.
Hinge forward at the hips, reaching toward your feet.
Stop when you feel a stretch behind your legs.
Relax your head and neck.
Hold for 30 to 60 seconds, about 5 to 8 slow breaths.
mistakes: Rounding hard to reach the toes

Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch.setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and one arm extended across your chest.
steps: Hold the arm just above the elbow with your other hand.
Gently pull the arm across your chest.
Keep your shoulders level and down.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch arms and repeat.

Wall Calf Stretch.setup: Stand facing a wall with hands on it at chest height, one foot back with the heel down and the other foot forward.
steps: Keep the back leg straight and the heel on the floor.
Point both feet straight ahead.
Lean your hips toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the back calf.
Hold for 30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch legs and repeat.

Butterfly Stretch.setup: Sit tall on the floor with the soles of your feet together and your knees dropped out to the sides.
steps: Hold your feet with both hands.
Sit tall and lengthen your spine.
Let your knees relax toward the floor.
Hinge forward slightly from the hips for a deeper stretch.
Hold for 30 to 60 seconds, about 5 to 8 slow breaths.

Static Neck Flexion and Extension.setup: An exercise to either build or warm-up front and back neck muscles.
steps: Stand or sit with your head in neutral position.
Place both of your hands on your forehead.
Press your head against your hands and contract your neck muscles.
Keep your head from moving forward. Hold for at least 30 seconds.
Repeat with hands on the back of your head, pressing against them.

Static Neck Side Flexion.setup: Stand or sit with your head in neutral position.
steps: Place your left hand against the left side of your head, above your ear.
Push your head against your hand, without moving your head.
Repeat with your right hand, right side of your head.
cues: Make sure you maintain your chin at a 90 degree angle to your neck.

Seated Military Press.setup: Sit on the bench with your toes pointing straight out, back straight and abs drawn in.
steps: Grip the bar with your palms facing outwards and your hands shoulder width apart.
With bar in front of your head, press upwards extending your arms but not locking them.
Pause at the top and then in a controlled movement lower the bar to the starting position.
cues: Ensure your hips, knees and ankles are at 90 degree positions to ensure optimal posture.
This exercise can also be performed with the bar in the starting position behind your head.

Cable Shrug.setup: Attach a pulley to the lowest setting on cable machine.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your abs drawn and your back straight.
Start with the pulley at waist height.
Grasp the pulley and shrug your shoulders up while keeping your arms extended.
Hold this position for a moment then with a controlled motion return to the starting position of the pulley to waist height.
cues: Bend your knees slightly when standing.

Smith Machine Upright Row.setup: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your abs drawn in.
steps: Place the bar on the Smith Machine in the position where your arms are fully extended in front of you.
Place your hands shoulder width apart and raise the bar up towards your chin with a controlled motion.
Pause at the top for a moment and rotate your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar to the starting position.
cues: Ensure you do not arch your back when pulling the bar up towards your chin.

Cable Upright Row.setup: Attach a straight bar to the pulley on the floor.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your abs drawn in and your back straight.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grasp (your palms facing downwards) and pull it up towards your waist, this is the starting position.
Raise the bar up to in line with your shoulders.
Pause at the top and rotate your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar in a controlled motion to the starting position.
cues: Do not arch your back when raising the bar to your shoulders.

Dumbbell Upright Row.setup: Grasp a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip (palms facing downwards) and hold them in front of your thighs.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your abs drawn in and your back straight.
Starting with the dumbbells at your thighs, slowly raise them up towards your shoulders by bending your elbows.
Pause at the top and rotate your shoulder blades together.
Lower the dumbbells in a controlled motion to your thighs.
Repeat.
cues: Do not arch your back when raising the dumbbells towards your shoulders.
Ensure the dumbbells are held close to your body throughout the exercise.
Do not perform this exercise if you have wrist, shoulder or elbow pain.

Bent-Over Cable Lateral Raise.setup: Grasp the handle of the low pulley with your right hand.
steps: Bend forward from the waist; your upper body should be nearly parallel with the floor. Bend your knees slightly and place your left hand on your left thigh. Let your right arm hang from your shoulder in front of you with your elbow slightly bent. This is your starting position.
Lift your right arm, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Keep moving your arm until it is parallel to the floor, in line with your right ear.
Slowly bring the weight back down to the starting position.
Perform exercise on left arm and then repeat.
cues: Start with a lower weight in order to perfect the technique.
Ensure your back remains straight throughout this exercise in order to prevent injury.

Ball Wall Circles.setup: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.
steps: Place a Swiss ball at chest height against a wall and with your left hand, roll the ball in small circles against the wall.
Keep your arm fully extended with a slight bend in the elbow.
Reverse the direction of the circles.
Switch arms.
cues: Maintain a good upright posture throughout this exercise.
Ensure the swiss ball is inflated enough to allow for smooth rhythmical circles.

Banded Reverse Fly.setup: Place an exercise band around a post or machine at mid chest height.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, abs drawn in and knees slightly bent.
Stand back from the post so there is tension in the band, grasping the band with your arms extended in front of you and a slight bend in your elbows; this is your starting position.
Bring your arms back in a controlled motion till they are parallel at your sides and in line with your shoulders.
Slowly return your arms to the starting position in front of your chest.
Repeat.
cues: Maintain a good upright posture at all times during this exercise ensuring you do not arch your back.

Flat Bench Leg Raise.setup: Lie on a flat bench with your hands under your hips supporting your back.
steps: Your legs should be unsupported by the bench from below your knees.
With your feet together and your toes flexed upwards, raise your straight legs up a few cm off the bench; both of your legs should have no contact with the bench. This is your starting position.
Keep your legs straight with a slight bend in the knees and raise your legs to just before 90 degrees with your hips.
Pause at the top and lower your legs in slow controlled manner back to the starting position.
Repeat.
cues: If you are pregnant you should contact your doctor prior to doing this exercise.
Ensure your back stays in contact with the bench at all times during this exercise.

Smith Machine Rear Delt Row.setup: This is an exercise for rear deltoid,shoulder, biceps and back strengthening.
steps: Set the bar to the lowest setting.
Place your feet shoulder width apart with a slight bend in the knees.
Bend at the waist while keeping your back straight and chest parallel to the floor.
